content.text: **Summary:** I resolved ticket T-2005 by identifying that the ledger-export cronjob is failing because the job execution time is exceeding the configured 1-hour activeDeadlineSeconds timeout. The last two runs failed with "DeadlineExceeded" errors, while an earlier run succeeded. The fix is to increase the activeDeadlineSeconds value in the CronJob spec to allow sufficient time for the job to complete.
